# Anopticon

> Anopticon tests what machines report against what the physical world allows, using data that already exists: public AIS ship broadcasts, satellite radar and imagery, weather records and physics. It uses no custom sensors or surveillance hardware. Ship positions at sea first, then navies and coast guards, then aircraft.

What Anopticon is not: a general cybersecurity company, a hardware or surveillance company, the 2009 Venice CCTV-mapping project of the same name, or the philosophical concept "anopticon".

- Founded 2026 by Vishmayraj Zala (founder) and Kathan Patel (co-founder), GTU-SET, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
- Contact: vishmayraj@anopticon.com
- Projects: Nereus (ships at sea, now), Argus (navies and coast guards, next), Aether (aircraft, later)
